notes: S1MB blog (hotchpotch, community article, Sept 30 2026): "Jev 1.13 ranks first with a Borda Score of 86.51. My bekko-system-one-v0-400m is second at 76.21." Broad coverage (137 benchmarks, 95 complete models) but the author's own models are on the board with a disclosed train/eval overlap, and Clef, Clef-flash, Perplexity and OpenAI Decisions are absent (Liquid d1 only on 6 generalisation benchmarks). No latency or cost. Open-Jev-9B (Borda 72.54, Task Avg 52.10) has no registry id and is not stored.
